pages.text: The Bog Toad is the swamp's oldest resident and its most patient predator. It lurks in shallows and on the banks of swamps and mangrove swamps, hops to close a gap, and bites with a venom that ogres have learned to dread.$(br2)Its bite inflicts $(thing)Bogrot II$() for 45 seconds.
Heavy hops land hard. Anyone caught beneath one is Dazed.

pages.title: Territory
pages.text: Toads treat the mire as their own and drive off ogres that wander in. Grunts, Archers, Mages, Guards and Trappers are fair game; Brutes, Captains and the Ogre King are not.$(br2)Players are prey too, and nothing calms them: not fish, not a gift, not patience. A toad is never hostile to a Plague Ogre.

pages.title: Spoils
pages.text: Toads drop $(item)Bog Toad Skin$(), $(item)Raw Toad Legs$() and, often, $(item)Bog Toad Venom$(). A rare $(item)Bogfang$() may be pulled from a kill; Looting improves every roll.$(br2)Raw Toad Legs come out already cooked if the toad dies burning.

pages.title: Eggs
pages.text: Toads cannot be bred. New ones come from $(item)Bog Toad Eggs$() laid on the muddy banks. Near water an egg hatches into a $(thing)Bog Pole$(), which feeds on cod, salmon and tropical fish and grows into a toad in time. A swamp only supports so many, so eggs wait while the area is crowded.
